message: 気になって、その気になって

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn. Did you do the math homework?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, uh, could you let me copy it later?」

name: Synn
message: 「Jeez, what am I gonna do with you」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Woohoo, that's my Synn! I knew I could count on you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Must be nice being you, Mako-chan. Not having homework and all」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron works hard at plenty of other things. Maybe you should take a page out of her book, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, by the way. The other day, Sacchin was saying--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn. You didn't do something to Mako-chan, did you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Suspicious... As if I wasn't already worried enough about the two of you living together」

name: Synn
message: 「How many times do I have to tell you, we're not living together」

name: Paqy
message: 「Things are super awkward 'cause Master Synn tried to peep on Shorty changing!」

name: Synn
message: 「And Paqy, why are you making up lies like that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I saw it in a dream. I bet you anything it's gonna come true!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you ever pull something like that, I won't forgive you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, even if I peeked into the room, Macaron changes inside a tent so there's no way I could see anything anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I see, I see, well that's a relief--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ow! How do you know about that!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... You poked the hornet's nest」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though this happens all the time...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What am I getting so worked up about...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my, President. Is that all you're having for lunch?」

name: Synn
message: 「Believe it or not, this extra-large cabbage bread actually fills you up pretty well」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That won't do at all for a growing boy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Allow me to share some of my bento with you!」

name: Misa
message: 「The Student Council President begging for food?! Don't do something so disgraceful!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Heeere you go, sorry for the wait!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. A strategy to fill up his stomach with water, is it?」

name: Misa
message: 「...I-I wouldn't mind sharing a little bit of my bento with you, you know...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Besides, I already have milk to drink...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's free, so just drink as much as you can!」

name: Misa
message: 「Come on, your cute little sister went out of her way for you, so you mustn't let it go to waste♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, it's totally fine if Big Brother gets along with everyone on the Student Council...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why am I letting this bother me so much...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ehehe. I came to pick you up!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm walking home with you, so hurry up and let's go!」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, there's something I forgot to mention about tomorrow's meeting」

name: Ria
message: 「The Holy Night Festival is next month too, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it's better if we decide on whatever we can ahead of time」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Macaron. Could you head home ahead of me?」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think it'll take that long, though」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'd feel bad making her wait」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's fine, I don't mind at all」

name: Macaron
message: 「Stuff like that never bothered me at all until now...」

name: Macaron
message: 「To think I'd get this worked up over Onii-chan...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's because I... love Onii-chan, isn't it...」

name: Macaron
message: 「S-Saying it out loud like that really packs a punch...」

name: Macaron
message: 「B-But, when the time comes, I'm gonna say it properly! I really will...」
